# `lobbying_filings`

**Lobbying disclosure filings**

One row per federal lobbying-disclosure filing, ingested from the U.S. Senate Lobbying Disclosure Act (LDA) REST API (`lda.gov`, formerly `lda.senate.gov`) by `build_lobbying_filings`. Registrants file quarterly reports naming the clients they lobby for, the money involved, the issues raised, and the government entities (agencies/chambers) lobbied — so this table links the comment campaigns in `comments`/`dockets` to the same organizations' *direct* agency lobbying. Primary / dedup key is `filing_uuid`.

**Coverage.** Sampled from retained Senate Lobbying Disclosure Act API captures. The snapshot has known gaps in filing years 1999–2006. Later filings may be absent. Some posting dates supplied by the publisher are anomalous. *(measured 2026-10-30)*

**Data quality.** Filing years 1999-2006 are short of the LDA's declared totals: offset paging over tied posting times skipped 12,853 filings in the one walk held (measured 2026-10-30, filings missing of declared): 1999 2,099 of 31,498; 2000 584 of 31,555; 2001 676 of 35,897; 2002 1,429 of 38,352; 2003 2,669 of 43,292; 2004 1,969 of 44,704; 2005 2,180 of 49,353; 2006 1,247 of 49,068. Filing years 2007 to 2025 matched their declared totals.

- **Parquet file:** `lobbying_filings.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filing_uuid` | `VARCHAR` | LDA filing UUID (e.g. `7866327b-c892-4430-b9f0-1f0f679c58c6`). Primary key / dedup key. |
| `filing_type` | `VARCHAR` | The LDA filing-type code as the API states it: `RR` registration; `Q1`–`Q4` quarterly reports and `MM` the pre-2008 mid-year report; `1A`–`4A` and `MA` amendments; `1T`–`4T` and `MT` terminations; `1@`–`4@` and `M@` termination amendments; a trailing `Y` marks a no-activity report (`Q1Y`, `1@Y`). The LDA constants endpoint (`/api/v1/constants/filing/filingtypes/`) is the authority. An amendment is a separate filing that restates its quarter's report. Quarterly interpretation belongs to `lobbying_quarterly_profiles`, which excludes registrations (`RR`, `RA`), uses exact native registrant/client identifiers and preserves unresolved competitors. Posting time alone does not establish an amendment chain. Terminations and no-activity suffixes do not imply zero amounts. |
| `filing_year` | `BIGINT` | Calendar year the filing reports on. |
| `filing_period` | `VARCHAR` | Reporting period within the year (e.g. `first_quarter`, `year_end`). |
| `dt_posted` | `TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE` | Timestamp the filing was posted to the LDA system (ISO 8601 string with timezone). Sort key. |
| `registrant_name` | `VARCHAR` | Name of the registrant (the lobbying firm or self-filing organization). |
| `registrant_id` | `VARCHAR` | LDA registrant id. Stable join key across a registrant's filings. |
| `client_name` | `VARCHAR` | The client's name as the registrant filed it; a name, not an identity. A self-filing organization is both registrant and client, often under a spelling other registrants do not use for it (McKesson files as `MCKESSON CORPORATION & AFFILIATES …`). `registrant_id` keys the registrant across its filings and `client_id` keys a client only within one registrant (see `client_id`); a match to `comments.organization` or `sam_entities.legal_business_name` is a name match. |
| `client_id` | `VARCHAR` | LDA's `client.id`: one registrant's record of one client, stable across that registrant's filings, not an organization identity. No id is shared between registrants (129,434 ids for 129,434 registrant-client pairs, measured 2026-10-03), so an organization hired by several firms has one id per firm (AT&T Services, Inc.: 21 ids under 21 registrants in 2025). |
| `income` | `DECIMAL(38,6)` | Lobbying income reported by a lobbying firm for the period, in USD. Null for self-filers (who report `expenses`). An amended report (`filing_type` `1A`–`4A`) restates its quarter's amount, often unchanged, so summing over every filing counts that quarter twice; use the explicit selection and unresolved statuses in `lobbying_quarterly_profiles` rather than choosing solely by latest posting. |
| `expenses` | `DECIMAL(38,6)` | Lobbying expenses reported by a self-filing organization for the period, in USD. Null for firms (who report `income`). An amended report (`filing_type` `1A`–`4A`) restates its quarter's amount, often unchanged, so summing over every filing counts that quarter twice; use the explicit selection and unresolved statuses in `lobbying_quarterly_profiles` rather than choosing solely by latest posting. A self-filing organization's expenses already include what it pays outside lobbying firms, whose `income` for that client is reported separately; do not add the two. |
| `lobbying_activities` | `STRUCT(general_issue_code VARCHAR, general_issue_code_display VARCHAR, description VARCHAR)[]` | Native list of lobbying activities, each `{general_issue_code, general_issue_code_display, description}` — the issue areas lobbied and their free-text descriptions. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct. |
| `government_entities` | `STRUCT(id VARCHAR, "name" VARCHAR)[]` | Government entities named on the filing, in order of first appearance. A rebuilt filing lists each source ID once and uses the source name when the ID is absent. The activity rows retain every occurrence. Earlier native generations may repeat entities at filing level. A missing activity list yields null and an empty activity list yields an empty result. |
| `filing_type_display` | `VARCHAR` | The publisher's label for `filing_type`, as served (e.g. `1st Quarter - Report`, `Registration`). |
| `filing_period_display` | `VARCHAR` | The publisher's label for `filing_period`, as served (e.g. `1st Quarter (Jan 1 - Mar 31)`). |
| `filing_document_content_type` | `VARCHAR` | Media type of the filing document (`url`), as LDA states it (e.g. `text/html`, `application/pdf`); null on the few filings that state none. |
| `expenses_method` | `VARCHAR` | The self-filer's expense accounting method code as filed (`expenses_method`). Two spellings occur, both kept as filed: lower case `a`, `b`, `c`, whose `expenses_method_display` is the long label, and upper case `A`, `B`, `C`, whose display is the bare letter; both occur in current years (a 400-page retained sample, 2026-10-30, held 751 lower-case and 286 upper-case codes). `a`/`A` is Method A (LDA definitions), `b`/`B` Method B (IRC 6033(b)(8)), `c`/`C` Method C (IRC 162(e)). Null when the filing states no method, as on most firm reports, which carry `income` instead. |
| `expenses_method_display` | `VARCHAR` | The publisher's label for `expenses_method`, as filed: `Method A - Reporting amounts using LDA definitions only`, `Method B - Reporting amounts under section 6033(b)(8) of the Internal Revenue Code`, `Method C - Reporting amounts under section 162(e) of the Internal Revenue Code`, or the bare letter when the code is upper case. |
| `termination_date` | `DATE` | Date the registrant ended its representation of the client, on a termination report (`filing_type` `1T`–`4T`, `MT` and their no-activity forms). Null on other filings. |
| `posted_by_name` | `VARCHAR` | Name of the person who signed and posted the filing, as entered (often with a title, e.g. `Frank J. Donatelli, Senior Advisor`). |
| `registrant_address_1` | `VARCHAR` | First line of the registrant's address as filed on this filing. The address can differ between a registrant's filings; it is the filing's own, not a current registrant profile. |
| `registrant_address_2` | `VARCHAR` | Second line of the registrant's address as filed on this filing; null when none was filed. |
| `registrant_city` | `VARCHAR` | City of the registrant's address as filed on this filing. |
| `registrant_state` | `VARCHAR` | State code of the registrant's address as filed on this filing (e.g. `DC`); null for an address outside the United States. |
| `registrant_zip` | `VARCHAR` | ZIP or postal code of the registrant's address as filed on this filing. |
| `registrant_country` | `VARCHAR` | Country of the registrant's address as filed on this filing, as the publisher displays it (e.g. `United States of America`), not a country code. |
| `registrant_ppb_country` | `VARCHAR` | Country of the registrant's principal place of business as filed, when the filing states one (display name); null otherwise. |
| `registrant_different_address` | `BOOLEAN` | The filing's flag for whether the registrant's principal place of business differs from the address filed: true, false, or null when the filing does not carry it (registrations among others). |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | The filing's `filing_document_url` as LDA served it: its printable document page (`https://lda.gov/filings/public/filing/<filing_uuid>/print/`; lda.senate.gov redirects there). Ten filings of 2006-2007 hold an API page address instead, as captured (measured 2026-11-11). |
